correctness.rationale: For n,m>=8 the three-round EF duplicator maintains sizes of all Venn cells either equal below 2^r or both >=2^r, preserving nonempty proper status and all atomic inclusion comparisons at r=0. For n=2..8, the nested extension-type sets B(x,y), U(x), H_n exactly encode the three-round EF game; permutation symmetry reduces x to each cardinality and all y,z are checked. An independently written brute-force bitset enumeration recomputed H_n at 2<=n<=8, finding 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 distinct pointed-type spectra respectively, hence seven mutually unequal classes. The finite computation is exhaustive only through n=8; EF induction proves the unbounded stable class. Rank-two pointed relation profiles distinguish n=2,3 and n>=4.
